preventativeNutritionSystem.narrative_synthesis: Rex inherited a Double Coat from their German Shepherd Dog ancestry. While advantageous for environmental adaptation and physiological resilience, in a Temperate Outdoor environment, this trait presents specific management considerations, such as a 16.1% incidence of Hip Dysplasia observed in German Shepherd Dog (Source: OFA Breed Registry). To proactively manage this, lifestyle modifications including Hydrotherapy treadmill are recommended. Furthermore, based on veterinary physiology, targeted nutritional intervention with Glucosamine is required at a dosage of 500 to support long-term health.
